snippet.title: NAUTUS | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
FROM THE CREATORS OF HAVE A NICE DEATH & UNRULY HEROES COMES NAUTUS: A CHARMINGLY QUIRKY ISLAND ADVENTURE GAME

Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2917940/NAUTUS

We’re excited to announce NAUTUS, a charmingly quirky island adventure where the surface is your cozy sanctuary, but the ocean floor is a whole different beast! This new, dual-layered, offbeat adventure is set to launch in Steam Early Access in 2027 -- with the release timing for
the game to be revealed at a later date.

In NAUTUS, players arrive at the remote N.A.U.T.U.S. research station following an unsettling radio message from their uncle, Bernard Torpedo. Upon arrival, they discover the resident scientists have lost their memories and developed a paralyzing fear of the ocean. As the only one willing to brave the depths, players must pilot an upgradable submarine, encounter mutant marine life, and recover mysterious artifact stones to restore the locals' memories and uncover the truth behind their uncle's sudden disappearance.
